keeper: PAR_STRONG/FULL/TILED/Fixed3, unchanged production binary; separate read-only Host observer binary

budget.repeat_condition: Only unresolved snapshot/diff determinism after a correct first replay; never for a favorable result
budget.warmup: same 19-event clone, destroyed and initial state restored; not snapshotted
budget.stop: First behavior, snapshot invariant, isolation or runtime failure. Preserve failures; CPU-only tool repair may reread saved evidence, no silent GPU retry

measurement: Diagnostic state/work only; instrumentation timing is not a performance result; no NCU/NSYS or external rerun
logical_delta: Since initial publication or last POST: mutation event counts, unique touched occurrence union, net live-set symmetric difference; both denominators reported
position: Persistent base row index; PRE pending occurrences have separate buffer row positions. Common live base occurrences compared; tombstones and new base admissions counted separately
leaf: SHA256 of sorted immutable occurrence IDs, full published and tombstone-filtered views; exact matches primary. Modified leaves use overlap-descending greedy 1:1 descriptive alignment, not stable identity
node: level + sorted subtree occurrence IDs; matched membership compares pivot occurrence and ordered child membership signatures, then legacy min_dis and FP64 lo/hi bit patterns. Unmatched memberships are structural changes
numeric: Bit-exact; canonical same-topology entries compared separately from structurally unmatched entries. Raw positional bit differences are secondary and cannot establish semantic redundancy
pack: All valid base FP32 coordinate entries, no padding/tail/request slots. Both physical-slot bit differences and occurrence-aligned coordinate equality; added/deleted occurrences separate
plan: All persistent vector payloads including CPU owners/offsets. Integer scalar count; Region has six scalars. No vector container or View addresses. Raw bytes and canonical logical payloads separately
work: Source-exact dynamic task counts from captured loop/dispatch state; library sort/scan input cardinalities are API work, not internal instructions. Never infer executed work solely from allocations
classification: Directly affected by updated occurrence dependency; changed remaining state is observed transitive churn, NOT proven necessary; unchanged canonical state is recomputed-but-identical
quality: All ordered IDs and FP32 field bits, query/event semantics, final occurrence set, two rebuild trigger steps equal frozen P2; all snapshot invariants pass; GPU kernel bodies remain byte-identical source

gates.GO_MAINTENANCE: both rebuilds: leaf/node changed <=20% and >=70% of processed canonical state identical; no heterogeneous-unit pooling
gates.STRONG_GO: GO plus unique logical mutation <0.01%, structural change <10%, maintenance touches about 100%
gates.NO_GO_LOCAL_MAINTENANCE: both rebuilds: changed leaf memberships >=70% OR changed node topology/numeric state >=70%

retention: Full private binary snapshots retained on experiment host with file hashes; large packed bytes not routed through client. Curated summaries/scripts published; small receipts/source/checker archived separately
